title: A forgotten fossil reveals a fearsome dinosaur with giant claws
caption:
A 120-million-year-old fossil was forgotten in a museum for nearly a century. It turns out, it’s a new species of predator that would have hunted humans for sport.

Source: Sciencedaily - A forgotten fossil reveals a fearsome dinosaur with giant claws
